name: Spellcraft Beginner Progression
status: current modular beginner progression through duration/protection
purpose: A Cuspell-first teaching progression with an 11-sign semantic core followed by small modules. Checkpoint 137 adds duration/maintenance and exact-event protection as separate stages rather than enlarging the core: ThisInterval + Persist first, then Prevent. The older 50-sign v0.1 file remains a broad coverage projection.
design_rules: teach one reusable semantic pattern at a time
teach Begin/End state transitions before acquisition, attributes, or creation
introduce Find only in its simple yes/no form
teach attribute-setting before fresh creation so Create can reuse an already-known Change pattern
introduce exactly one typed fresh binder in the creation module
teach an objectively designated TimeInterval reference before maintenance/prevention
teach Persist before Prevent so duration is learned on a StateProposition before nesting an EventSpec
teach only Prevent's simple exact-EventSpec form here; bound EventSpec interception remains advanced
keep the semantic core free of duration/protection, representation, multi-target programming, and time-flow machinery
syntax_taught_in_core: flat tight local application; parentheses are not required

first_actions.purpose: One movement Process plus a state that can begin or end.

reusable_state_vocabulary.purpose: Add an explicit other target plus two high-yield state words; no new grammar.

bounded_discovery.purpose: Add caster reference and simple factive yes/no Find.

starter_spells.name: Move selected thing
starter_spells.note: Move the designated subject to the designated destination.

starter_spells.name: Move another person
starter_spells.note: Reuse Move with the explicit target You.

starter_spells.name: Mark magical
starter_spells.note: Begin the Entity's Magic state; this does not by itself add a hidden magical behavior.

starter_spells.name: Dispel selected magic state
starter_spells.note: End the selected Entity's Magic state/effect marker.

starter_spells.name: Check integrity
starter_spells.note: Acquire the truthful yes/no answer about Whole.

starter_spells.name: Check whether it is locked
starter_spells.note: Acquire the truthful yes/no answer about Locked.

starter_spells.name: Detect magic
starter_spells.note: Acquire the truthful yes/no answer about the Entity's Magic state.

modules.name: Attribute change and Light

spells.name: Make an existing thing luminous
spells.note: Set the Light output of an already-existing designated Entity.

modules.rationale: Change has a three-part attribute-setting pattern and Light introduces a measured quantity, so it is taught after the 11-sign core instead of arriving together with Create.

modules.name: Fresh creation
syntax_additions: Create profile followed by one immediate continuation EventSpec

spells.name: Create light at the designated destination
spells.cuspell: Create x:Entity At $x There Change $x Light «LightUnit» @!
spells.note: Allocate one fresh spatial Entity at There, then immediately set that same fresh Entity's Light output.

modules.rationale: Creation genuinely needs binder scope and a profile/continuation distinction. It therefore reuses the already-known Light/Change pattern instead of teaching all of those ideas in one step.

modules.name: Duration and active maintenance
context_requirements: ThisInterval must resolve to one objectively designated TimeInterval supplied by the command/casting environment
ThisInterval is not a duration literal and does not mean forever

spells.name: Maintain integrity
spells.note: Actively maintain the selected Entity's Whole state against ordinary evolution for the designated interval. Persist is not taught as a synonym for Begin.

spells.name: Keep locked
spells.note: Actively maintain the Locked state over the designated interval.

spells.name: Maintain magical state
spells.note: Actively maintain the Entity's Magic state over the designated interval.

modules.rationale: This stage adds one temporal reference plus one operator. It reuses StatePropositions already learned in the 11-sign core and introduces finite active maintenance without event matching.

modules.name: Exact-event protection

spells.name: Prevent movement to the destination
spells.note: Block the exact Move(This, There) EventSpec over the designated interval.

spells.name: Protect against being broken by this state transition
spells.note: Block the exact End Whole This EventSpec over the designated interval; this does not automatically describe every physical way Whole might cease.

spells.name: Prevent locking
spells.note: Block the exact Begin Locked This EventSpec over the designated interval.

modules.teaching_scope: Only Prevent(event, interval) is taught here. The bound matcher form with e:EventSpec, predicates, optional Region scope, and generic antimagic interception is deferred to advanced spell programming.
modules.rationale: Prevent adds one semantic sign but one new structural idea: an EventSpec is passed as the thing to block. Teaching it after Persist means the learner already understands the interval argument.

optional_vocabulary.purpose: Convenience Location reference for caster-local effects; not required because There already supplies a designated Location.
optional_vocabulary.example: Create x:Entity At $x Here Change $x Light «LightUnit» @!

optional_vocabulary.purpose: Example of ordinary state-vocabulary expansion after Begin/End/Find are learned.

deferred_modules.name: advanced protection and magical interception
deferred_modules.note: The simple exact-event Prevent form is taught in checkpoint 137. Bound e:EventSpec predicate/Region interception remains advanced.

deferred_modules.name: shared representation
deferred_modules.note: Teach after basic Create; persistent illusion is composition, not a beginner primitive.
